item.title: In Opinion If A.I. “could destroy human life on earth, why …
item.author: The New York Times (@nytimes.com)
item.description:
In Opinion

If A.I. “could destroy human life on earth, why continue to build it? Often the answer is that since its development is inevitable, responsible actors need to get there first,” Michelle Goldberg writes. But that explanation “doesn’t account for tech leaders’ messianic dreams.”

item.author: はてなブックマーク 人気エントリー (@hatena-bookmark.bsky.social)
item.description:
